verdict.rationale: Zero's repository documents an official ZeroMCP server. It exposes a substantial tool list (thread retrieval, folder listing, compose/send, drafts, labels, bulk archive/delete, search, AI Q&A), so an agent can connect to and operate the mailbox. Connecting is crude, though: the only working method is copying a browser session cookie into the Authorization header, OAuth is 'coming soon', and an independent probe found only a prose capability list with no endpoint schema or docs site. Missing for 10: supported auth flow such as OAuth, endpoint/schema and connection setup docs, hands-on or independent corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: You can connecto ZeroMCP using two methods: 1. Better Auth session token 2. OAuth (Coming soon)
Copy the session cookie from your browser cookies and place it into the Authorization header.
Get email threads by ID - List emails in specific folders - Create and send new emails - Create email drafts - Send existing drafts - Delete emails
